title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Colony Count Organism

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Colony count: Colony count — number concentration of an organism', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Number concentration or logarithmic number concentration where the counted entity is an organism (Component or Inheres in). Parts: LOINC enumeration (16, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118550005 |Number concentration (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705056007 |Logarithmic number concentration (property) (qualifier value)|), (246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)| OR 704319004 |Inheres in (attribute)| = << 410607006 |Organism (organism)|)`
